vintage: GUS population 31 December 2025; demographic rates and life expectancy 2025; university students 31 December 2025; territorial division 1 January 2026
gdp_vintage: Eurostat national 2025; voivodeship GDP 2024; NUTS3 GDP 2023; GVA 2023

yields.label: Food
yields.description: Workers in agriculture, forestry and fishing (PKD section A), counted where the employer is (GUS, 31 December 2025). Powiaty and cities with powiat rights: PKD section A; other gminas: the GUS agriculture sector of the gmina table.

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Workers in industry and construction (PKD sections B-F), counted where the employer is (GUS, 31 December 2025). Powiaty and cities with powiat rights: the PKD sections (a section GUS withholds counts as absent); other gminas: the GUS industry and construction sector of the gmina table.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross domestic product per year in current złoty. Poland: 2025 (GUS, through Eurostat). Voivodeships: 2024 (Eurostat NUTS 2). Powiaty: the 2023 GDP of their NUTS 3 subregion, shared among the subregion's powiaty by their wage bill (average wage x workers). Gminas: their powiat's GDP in proportion to their workers. Towns and metros: the sum of their gminas. Below the voivodeship level the figure is a share of a published total, not a published GDP.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Workers in information and communication (J) and in professional, scientific and technical activities (M), counted where the employer is (GUS, 31 December 2025). Published per powiat; a gmina gets its powiat's figure in proportion to its service workers (exact for cities with powiat rights).

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Workers in accommodation and food service (I) and in arts, entertainment and recreation (R), counted where the employer is (GUS, 31 December 2025). Shared to gminas like Science.
